receipts.wisdom: You are not fitting a tool to jobs; you are the invariant. State it once at full fidelity and emit it so the one job that needs exactly it finds you. Sanding the oddness to look applicable is the failure mode, not the strategy -- the oddness is the selectivity. An external gatekeeper multiplies reach only when you hand them a self-emitting object aimed past them at the decider, with the sensitive re-sell air-gapped by which vertex owns the argument. Mirror the decider's own distinctive words back ('to sunset'); recognition is what makes the pull feel effortless.
